an4.84:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.84:1.3: kodhagaru hoti na saddhammagaru, makkhagaru hoti na saddhammagaru, lābhagaru hoti na saddhammagaru, sakkāragaru hoti na saddhammagaru.
an4.84:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.84:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.84:2.3: saddhammagaru hoti na kodhagaru, saddhammagaru hoti na makkhagaru, saddhammagaru hoti na lābhagaru, saddhammagaru hoti na sakkāragaru.
an4.84:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’ti.
